[{"element": "menu_content", "data": {"key": "components_menu_content", "id": "components_menu_content", "name": "components_menu_content"}, "elements": [{"element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Overview", "key": "md_comp_overview", "id": "components-overview", "name": "md_comp_overview", "value": "# Components Reference Everything you place in the designer is an **element**: a node with an `element` type, its `data` (properties) and, for containers, child `elements`. Form elements become database columns; layout, content and media elements only shape the UI. ```json { "element": "feature_card", "data": { "title": "Fast setup", "text": "Ready in minutes.", "icon": "Zap", "variant": "elevated", "animation": "fade-up" }, "elements": [] } ``` You rarely write this by hand: the designer maintains it, and the **element editor** (click an element) shows exactly the properties listed here. --- ## Element Groups | Group | Elements | Offered in | |-------|----------|-----------| | **Layout** | `section`, `div`, `grid`, `row`, `col`, `panel`, `tabs`, `tab`, `modal`, `menu_content` | Everywhere | | **Content** | `heading`, `paragraph`, `text_block`, `markdown`, `icon`, `link`, `button`, `list`, `separator`, `spacer` | Everywhere | | **Media** | `image`, `gallery`, `carousel`, `video_embed`, `before_after`, `embed` | Pages, forms | | **Components** | `feature_card`, `banner`, `review`, `contact_form`, `particles`, `accordion`, `accordion_item`, `steps`, `stats`, `pricing_plan`, `business_hours`, `contact_links`, `whatsapp_button` | Pages | | **Data** | `collection`, `collection_view`, `entity`, `form` | Pages | | **App elements** | Provided by installed apps, e.g. `stripe_plans` (app `control`) — see *App elements* below | Pages | | **Meta** | `seo` | Pages | | **Form** | `input`, `password`, `date`, `date_time`, `time`, `select`, `connection`, `radio_group`, `textarea`, `markdown_input`, `checkbox`, `switch`, `range`, `rating`, `form_table`, `file_input`, `image_input`, `color_picker`, `icon_input` | Entities, forms | | **Print** | `letterhead`, `doc_header`, `doc_field`, `doc_table`, `doc_section`, `doc_body`, `page_break` | Print Format Builder only — see [Printing](/printing) | | **Desk** | `shortcut`, `number_card`, `quick_list`, `module_cards`, `chart`, `dashboard` | Desk Page Builder only — see [Desk Pages](/desk-pages) | --- ## Common Properties Every element's editor has the same base tabs: | Property | Description | |----------|-------------| | Content texts | Each element declares its own (see *Content vocabulary* below) | | `name` | Field name (form elements), internal name otherwise | | `class` | Tailwind classes merged into the element | | `background_image` / `background_color` / `background_blend_mode` / `background_size` | Background | | `inline_css` | Raw CSS for the element | | `text_align` | Text alignment | | `hidden` / `disabled` | Hide or disable | | `animation` / `animation_duration` / `animation_delay` | Entrance animation (see Animations) | | `id` | Anchor id (`#id` links scroll to it) | | `display_on` | Condition that decides when the element is shown | | `visible_on` | All screens, mobile only or desktop only | | `attributes` | Custom HTML attributes on the element's root: `data-*`, `aria-*`, `role`, `itemprop`, `itemscope`, `itemtype`, `rel`, `title`, `lang`… (event handlers, `style`, `class` and `id` are ignored) | ### Content vocabulary Visible texts use the same names in every element: | Prop | Meaning | Used by | |------|---------|---------| | `title` | Main text of a block | `feature_card`, `panel`, `accordion_item`, `pricing_plan`, `business_hours`, `modal`, `collection`, `form`, `review`, `video_embed`, `embed` | | `text` | Body / plain text (the only text of single-text elements) | `heading`, `paragraph`, `div`, `feature_card`, `accordion_item`, `pricing_plan` | | `label` | Text of a control or field | `link`, `button`, `tab`, `tabs`, `separator`, form fields; a section/markdown/div entry inside `menu_content` | | `description` | Secondary text | `panel`, `modal`, `collection`, `review`, form fields | | `items` | A list, one entry per line | `list`, `steps`, `stats`, `business_hours` | | `value` | Markdown | `markdown` | Each element's definition declares its texts (`content` in `element-definition.js`): the designer, translations and AI generation all read it from there. "}}, {"element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Layout", "key": "md_comp_layout", "id": "components-layout", "name": "md_comp_layout", "value": "# Layout --- ## Section Full-width page band; the primary building block of a page. | Property | Description | |----------|-------------| | `gap` | Space between its rows (0–6, rem) | | `padding_y` | Vertical padding | | `full_width` | Remove the max-width constraint | | `min_height` | Content, half screen or full screen | | `content_align` | Vertical position of the content (top, center, bottom) | | `background_video` / `video_overlay` | Muted looping .mp4/.webm behind the content, with a darkening overlay | In the designer every section can be collapsed to make long pages easier to edit; visitors always see it expanded. ## Div The generic container (like Webflow's Div Block): | Property | Description | |----------|-------------| | `tag` | HTML tag: `div`, `section`, `article`, `header`, `footer`, `nav`, `ul`/`li`, `p`, `h1`–`h6`, `details`/`summary`… (scripts, styles and iframes are not offered) | | `text` | Inner text | | `display` | Block, `flex`, `grid` or inline block | | `direction` / `wrap` | Flex direction and wrapping | | `columns` / `stack_on_mobile` | Grid columns (one column on mobile by default) | | `align` / `justify` / `gap` | Alignment and spacing of the children | ## Grid Auto-fit grid for repeated items (cards, logos, team): set `min_width` (xs 10rem … xl 24rem) and `gap`; as many columns fit as there is room for. ## Modal A button (`trigger_label`, `trigger_variant`, `trigger_icon`) that opens a dialog with `title`, `description` and any content dropped inside. `width`: sm … xl. --- ## Row A grid of columns. Columns are created and removed to match the layout. | Property | Description | |----------|-------------| | `layout` | Relative column widths, e.g. `[1,1]`, `[1,2]`, `[1,1,1]` — pick it from the layout chip in the designer | | `gap` | Space between columns (0–6, rem) | | `col_padding` | Padding inside every column | | `vertical_alignment` | How columns align when their heights differ | | `stack_on` | Container width below which columns stack (sm 40rem, md 48rem…) | | `reverse_on_mobile` | Show the last column first once stacked | | `row_height` | Minimum height as a share of the viewport | Rows respond to the width of their **container**, not the window, so a row inside a narrow column stacks correctly. ## Col A column of a row; holds any elements. --- ## Panel A styled surface for grouping content. | Property | Values | |----------|--------| | `title` / `description` | Optional header above the content | | `variant` | `glass`, `solid`, `gradient`, `outline`, `glow` | | `rounded` | `none` … `3xl` | | `padding` | `none` … `2xl` | | `bg_color` / `bg_opacity` / `backdrop_blur` | Background | | `border_color` / `border_opacity` / `border_width` | Border | | `glow_color` / `glow_opacity` | Glow (variant `glow`) | | `hoverable` / `focusable` | Interaction states | ## Tabs · Tab `tabs` holds `tab` children; each tab's `label` is its title. `variant`: pills or underline; `orientation`: horizontal or vertical (desktop). Tabs switch with the keyboard too (arrows, Home, End). ## Menu Content A documentation-style layout: each child becomes a section with an entry in a side menu (this page is built with it). "}}, {"node": "md_comp_content", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Content", "key": "md_comp_content", "id": "md_comp_content", "name": "md_comp_content", "value": "# Content | Element | Description | Key properties | |---------|-------------|----------------| | `heading` | Heading `h1`–`h6` | `text`, `level` (semantic, use one `h1` per page), `size` (visual: `display`, `5xl`…`sm`; empty = the level's default) | | `paragraph` | Body text | `text`, `size` (sm … xl), `text_align` | | `markdown` | Rendered Markdown (GFM, tables, code highlighting) | `value` | | `icon` | A Lucide icon | `icon` | | `link` | Link | `to` (URL or path), `target` (`_self` / `_blank`), `variant`, `size`, `icon`, `icon_position` | | `button` | Button | `action`, `variant`, `size`, `icon`, `icon_position`, `slide`, `slide_text`, `slide_confirmed_text` | | `list` | Checked, bulleted or numbered list | `items` (one per line), `ordered`, `icon`, `columns` | | `separator` | Horizontal rule, optionally labeled | `label`, `spacing`, `line_style` | | `spacer` | Empty vertical space | `height` (`xs`…`xl`, responsive) | ### Button actions `action` names a handler: in a form it calls the matching action of the view (`useHandlers`) or a built-in like `save`. With `slide` on, the button becomes a **slide-to-confirm** control — useful for destructive or sensitive actions. ### Links inside the site Use paths of the menu (`/Doc/Getting Started`, `/getting-started`): the web router resolves them case- and separator-insensitively. "}}, {"element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Form Fields", "key": "md_comp_fields", "id": "components-fields", "name": "md_comp_fields", "value": "# Form Fields Form elements store data: inside an entity, each one becomes a column of its table. | Element | Stores | Notes | |---------|--------|-------| | `input` | Text / numbers | `format` sets validation and column type: `data`, `email`, `phone`, `url`, `text`, `int`, `float`, `decimal`, `currency`, `percent`, `uuid`…; `min_length`, `max_length`, `pattern` + `pattern_message` | | `password` | Hashed / encrypted secret | Never sent back to the browser | | `textarea` | Long text | | | `markdown_input` | Markdown | The rich text editor (with preview) | | `date` · `date_time` · `time` | Dates | Date range limits are configurable | | `checkbox` · `switch` | 0 / 1 | | | `select` | Text | A fixed list: `options` one per line (`value` or `value:Label`); a line `# Label` or `# value:Label` opens a group. `parent`: another field of the form — only the group whose value matches it is offered (`# HN:Honduras` → its cities when the parent is `HN`) | | `connection` | Record name | Records of another entity (`options`: the entity, picked from the Entity Directory), searched on the server as you type, with a **+** to create one. `group_by`: a field of that entity to group by. `parent` + `parent_filter`: cascade — only records whose `parent_filter` field equals the value of the form's `parent` field (checked on save too); with `parent_filter` empty, the field of that entity connecting to the parent's entity is used (city → `state` when the parent is a connection to State). `filters`: fixed conditions, one `field = value` per line | | `radio_group` | Text | Visible choices from `options` (one per line); `multiple` turns it into checkboxes (JSON list); `layout` vertical / horizontal | | `range` | Number | Slider: `min`, `max`, `step`, `unit` | | `rating` | Integer | Stars, `max` 3–10 | | `form_table` | Child rows | `options`: the child entity (`is_child`). Rows keep their order | | `file_input` · `image_input` | File reference | Managed by the File Manager (see [Storage](/storage)) | | `color_picker` | Color | | | `icon_input` | Icon name | Lucide picker | ### Entity Directory In the Element Editor, entities and fields are picked, not typed: `options` of a connection, collection, form table, form, number card, quick list, shortcut and entity element list the tenant's entities (grouped by app), and `group_by` / `parent_filter` list the fields of the chosen entity. `parent` lists the other fields of the form being designed. The lists come from **Entity Directory**, a virtual entity (no table) over the registry. A connection to it chooses what is listed with `filters`: | Filter | Lists | |--------|-------| | `mode = records` (default) | Entities that hold records (not pages or other singles, not child tables) | | `mode = child` | Child tables | | `mode = all` | Every entity and page | | `mode = fields` | Fields of the entity given by the `parent` value (or `entity = …`); `kinds = discrete` (default: select, radio group, single connection, switch, checkbox), `scalar` (any one comparable value) or `all` | ### Field properties | Property | Description | |----------|-------------| | `name` | Column name (snake_case) | | `label` | Display label | | `required` · `unique` | Constraints, checked on save; a required field shows an asterisk | | `required_on` | Condition that makes the field required (same syntax as `display_on`), checked in the form and on the server | | `default_value` | Initial value for new records (the *Default* field of the editor) | | `write_policy` | `editable`, `display_only` (shown read-only, view code may fill it), `create_only`, `readonly` (server code only), `protected`, `system` | | `hidden` | Display state | | `in_list_view` · `searchable` | Show in the list / include in search | | `description` | Help text under the field | | `options` | For `select`, `connection`, `radio_group` and `form_table` (see above) | | `multiple` · `min_items` · `max_items` · `display` | `select` / `connection`: several values (JSON list), with limits checked in the form and on save; shown as `chips` (searchable) or `checkboxes` | Naming: give fields stable snake_case names before data exists — renaming a field later renames its column. "}}, {"element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Media", "key": "md_comp_media", "id": "components-media", "name": "md_comp_media", "value": "# Media | Element | Description | Key properties | |---------|-------------|----------------| | `image` | Image (a real ``, lazy-loaded) | `background_image` (the image), `alt`, `aspect_ratio`, `background_size` (cover/contain), `eager` (for the hero image) | | `gallery` | Image grid with lightbox | `images` (multiple uploads), `source` (Local / Server), `page_size` | | `carousel` | Slides of any elements | `autoplay`, `interval`, `loop`, `pause` (on hover), `arrows`, `indicators`, `keyboard`, `touch`, `aspect_ratio`, `full_height`, `content_animation`, `view_mode`, `thumbs`, `lightbox` | | `video_embed` | Remote video | `title`, `video_url`, `aspect_ratio` (16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 1:1, 21:9), `poster`, `click_to_load`, `autoplay`, `muted`, `loop`, `hide_controls` | | `before_after` | Drag to compare two images | `before_image`, `after_image`, `before_label`, `after_label`, `position`, `aspect_ratio` | | `embed` | External page or Google Map in an iframe | `url` or `address` (map), `aspect_ratio`, `height`, `title` (iframe title) | ### `video_embed` Paste a plain video URL — the platform is detected and the right player is embedded: | Platform | URLs | |----------|------| | YouTube | watch, `youtu.be`, shorts, live (privacy-enhanced `youtube-nocookie`) | | Vimeo · Dailymotion | Video pages | | Facebook | videos, reels, watch | | TikTok | Video pages | | Direct file | `.mp4` and other video files | With **Click to load**, only the poster is shown until the visitor clicks — no third-party request before that. ### Carousel readability `text_background` puts text over a translucent card so it stays readable on any slide; `text_background_class` adds your own classes. "}}, {"element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Components", "key": "md_comp_cards", "id": "components-cards", "name": "md_comp_cards", "value": "# Components | Element | Description | Key properties | |---------|-------------|----------------| | `feature_card` | Highlight card with icon or image | `variant` (default / elevated / plain — no card, icon badge over title and text), `icon`, `icon_size`, `icon_opacity`, `align`, `image_height`, `overlay_intensity`, `content_position` (outside / overlay), `hover_effect` | | `banner` | Hero band with background and text | `align` (center / start / end), `full_height`, `text_background`, `text_background_class` | | `review` | Public reviews with ratings for the page | `title`, `description`, `show_avg` | | `contact_form` | Public form backed by a Contact Form entity | `entity`, `success_message`, `button_text`, `show_reset_button`, `reset_button_text` | | `particles` | Animated particle background | `particles_settings` (visual editor) | | `accordion` · `accordion_item` | Collapsible questions/answers (`
`, works without JS) | item: `title` (question), `text` (answer), `open`; accordion: `single` (one open at a time), `faq_schema` (FAQPage JSON-LD for Google) | | `steps` | Numbered process | `items` (`Title \| Description` per line), `orientation` | | `stats` | Key figures, counted up on scroll | `items` (`Value \| Label` per line), `columns`, `count_up` | | `pricing_plan` | One plan of a price list | `title`, `price`, `period`, `text`, `features` (one per line, `-` = not included), `button_label`, `to`, `highlighted`, `badge` | | `business_hours` | Opening hours | `title`, `items` (`Days \| Hours`), `note` | | `contact_links` | Phone, WhatsApp, email, address, socials | `layout` (list / inline / icons), one field per channel | | `whatsapp_button` | WhatsApp chat button | `phone`, `message`, `floating`, `position` | ### `contact_form` Pick an entity made with the **Contact Form Builder**. Submissions go through the anti-spam pipeline (honeypot, timing, scoring, captcha) and are stored as records of that entity — see [Website](/website#website-forms). ### `review` Visitors leave a rating and comment; reviews are held for approval and the average can be shown. "}}, {"node": "md_comp_data", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Data", "key": "md_comp_data", "id": "md_comp_data", "name": "md_comp_data", "value": "# Data Elements | Element | Description | Key properties | |---------|-------------|----------------| | `entity` | Renders an entity's view inside a page | `name` (entity), `action` (controller action, e.g. `create`) | | `form` | A form whose fields you drop inside it | `title`, `action`, `action_text`, `success_message`, `error_message`, `notify_email` | | `collection` · `collection_view` | Listing and detail page of any entity | See Collections below | | `seo` | Page title, description and meta tags | — | ## App elements An app can ship its own page elements in `apps//elements/`: ``` apps//elements/ ├── elements.json # definitions └── my-element.jsx # one component per element (file name = element name with dashes) ``` ```json [{ "element": "my_element", "group": "components", "icon": "Sparkles", "content": { "title": "line", "text": "text" } }] ``` `group` is any non-form group (`layout`, `content`, `media`, `components`, `data`, `meta`). The designer only offers an app's elements on tenants where that app is installed, and a core element with the same name always wins. ### `form` Without an `action`, a `form` uses the generic pipeline: the page itself acts as the model, submissions are validated against the fields you placed, filtered for spam and stored as **Form Submission** records (with an optional email on each submission). Set `title` + `action` to send it to a controller action of your own instead. "}}, {"element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Animations", "key": "md_comp_animations", "id": "components-animations", "name": "md_comp_animations", "value": "# Animations Every element can play an entrance animation when it scrolls into view. Set it in the **Animation** tab of the element editor. | Property | Default | Description | |----------|---------|-------------| | `animation` | — | Effect (below) | | `animation_duration` | `1000` | Duration in ms | | `animation_delay` | `0` | Delay in ms | ```json { "element": "feature_card", "data": { "animation": "fade-up", "animation_duration": 600 } } ``` ## Available Effects | Family | Effects | |--------|---------| | Fade | `fade-up`, `fade-down`, `fade-left`, `fade-right` | | Slide | `slide-up`, `slide-down`, `slide-left`, `slide-right` | | Zoom | `zoom-in`, `zoom-out` | | Flip | `flip-up`, `flip-down` | | Random | `random` — picks one of the above | ## Staggered Animations Increment the delay of sibling elements for a cascading reveal: ```json [ { "element": "feature_card", "data": { "animation": "fade-up", "animation_delay": 0 } }, { "element": "feature_card", "data": { "animation": "fade-up", "animation_delay": 100 } }, { "element": "feature_card", "data": { "animation": "fade-up", "animation_delay": 200 } } ] ``` ## Best Practices | Do | Don't | |----|-------| | Use subtle effects | Animate everything | | Keep durations short (300–600 ms) | Use very long durations | | Stagger related elements | Mix many directions on one screen | "}}, {"element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Collections", "key": "md_comp_collections", "id": "components-collections", "name": "md_comp_collections", "value": "# Collections The `collection` element turns any entity into a public, data-driven listing (portfolio, services, blog...) with cards, pagination and detail pages — no custom page code. ## collection — the listing | Prop | Description | |------|-------------| | `options` | **Entity name** to list — the entity must expose a `publicActionPublicList` | | `title` / `description` | Header texts | | `page_size` | Items per page (1–48, default 12) | | `columns` | Card columns (1–4, default 3) | | `featured_only` | Show only featured records | | `category` / `tag` | Server-side filters | | `card_variant` | `default` or `compact` | | `empty_message` | Text when there are no results | Cards are resolved by convention: a `-card.jsx` component if one exists, otherwise a default card driven by the entity's schema (cover image, title, summary, tags). ## collection_view — the detail page | Prop | Description | |------|-------------| | `options` | Entity name — must expose `publicActionPublicView` | | `detail_layout` | `page` or `gallery` | | `back_label` / `back_href` | Back navigation | | `enable_comments` | Render a public comment block (moderated) | ## Slug routing Web URLs follow `//`: the first segment matches a menu item of the web app, the second is the record's `slug`. Unknown menu or unpublished/missing slugs return a proper **404 page**. ``` /projects → collection page (list) /projects/my-app → collection_view (detail via publicView slug lookup) ``` ## The entity contract The backing entity (e.g. `Project`, `Service`) provides: - `slug`, `published`, `featured` fields (plus whatever the cards should show: `cover_image`, `summary`, `tags`...) - `publicActionPublicList` — published-only, paginated list (`{items, total, page, page_size, total_pages}`) - `publicActionPublicView` — single published record by `slug` The `web` module ships `Project` (+ categories) and `Service` (+ categories) already wired this way, and a `review` entity for user ratings gated by an `approved` switch."}}, {"element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Payments (Stripe)", "key": "md_comp_stripe", "id": "components-stripe", "name": "md_comp_stripe", "value": "# Payments (Stripe) Configure the **Stripe** Single entity (Desk → Integrations) with your `public_key` and `secret_key`, then drop `stripe_plans` onto a page (an element of the `control` app). For a plain price list without payments use `pricing_plan`. ## stripe_plans — Plans grid with Checkout Fetches products/prices from Stripe (single source of truth — no local plan entity) and starts a Checkout session on click: | Prop | Description | |------|-------------| | `title` / `description` | Header texts | | `category` | `cloud`, `service` or `donation` — controls the signup dialog fields | | `group_by` | `price` or `product` | | `button_label` | CTA text | | `domain_suffix` | For cloud signups (default `.loopar.build`) |"}}], "imageProps": {}, "style": {}}]
